title: Batatoli oyo bakufaki
intro: Na eleko moko eleki kala, lisangá moko ezalaki kofanda na mabele oyo banzela ekabwani kati na ampire. Mosakoli na bango abengaki bango epai ya nzela ya bosolo, nzokande bakangamaki na kozanga kondima mpe na minyoko. Lisolo oyo esukaka na kozongisa mabe ya bonzambe. Okoki koyeba ekolo oyo mpe destin na bango na ba indices oyo ezali awa na se?
clues: Bato moko baboyaki likebisi oyo moko ya bamemi-nsango na bango moko amemaki.
Motindami abengaki biso tosambela Allah se moko mpe akebisaki na kanyaka.
Bobukami na biso ezalaki koboya profeta oyo atindamaki kati na biso na bosembo.
Tozalaki kotya ntembe na bokonzi ya momemi-nsango yango mpe tofundaki ye ete azali na bokosi.
Etumbu ezwaki biso ntango tozalaki kofanda na libateli na bandako na biso.
Tobebisamaki mpo na kowangana profeta na biso mpe konyokola bandimi.

trial.label: Momekano/Evenement
options: Koyamba profeta oyo abengaki na boyengebene
Kozala na ndoto oyo ba interprété
Kosala mobembo na kati ya mbu
trial.answer: Koyamba profeta oyo abengaki na boyengebene

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Bato babebisamaki mpo na kozanga kondima
Bato yango babikaki mpe bazwaki bozwi
Bato yango bakendaki kofanda na mokili ya sika
outcome.answer: Bato babebisamaki mpo na kozanga kondima

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
